profiles.name: OpenRouter
profiles.description: OpenRouter multi-model gateway — search and pick models from the server when adding; context length is auto-detected and recorded as a [Nk] suffix

profiles.name: LM Studio (local)
profiles.description: Local LM Studio server — replace model IDs with the identifiers loaded in LM Studio. Append a [128k]-style suffix (or add via ccx to auto-detect the loaded context) so Claude Code knows the real context window. `sessionHeader` makes ccx stamp a per-launch session id so a server that reuses KV state across turns can pin the conversation instead of guessing from the prompt prefix.

profiles.name: MTPLX / Anthropic-compatible local server
profiles.description: Local server that already speaks Anthropic /v1/messages. `auth: "anthropic"` runs a passthrough proxy (no payload translation) that rewrites Claude Code's mid-conversation `role:"system"` messages into `user` messages — Qwen-family chat templates reject a system message that is not first, so the server relocates it and the prompt prefix shifts every turn, forcing a full re-prefill. Pair it with `sessionHeader` so the server can pin the conversation.

profiles.name: lightning-mlx (local)
profiles.description: Lightning-MLX local server (Apple Silicon) — ccx runs a local OpenAI Chat Completions translation proxy and forwards to /v1/chat/completions. Replace model ID with the identifier reported by /v1/models (default: `local`). Append a `[128k]`-style context suffix — ccx translates it into Claude Code's context settings and strips it before forwarding upstream.

profiles.name: NVIDIA NIM
profiles.description: NVIDIA build.nvidia.com hosted models — OpenAI-compatible, so ccx runs a local translation proxy. Get a key at build.nvidia.com (free developer tier: ~1000 credits, ~40 RPM — it is account-wide, not per model). When adding, ccx offers a curated shortlist (GLM-5.2, MiniMax-M3, Nemotron 3 Ultra/Super, DeepSeek V4 flash/pro) of what the server is actually serving.

profiles.name: Codex
profiles.description: Route Codex via your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription — run `ccx codex login` first. The 272K ChatGPT backend context cap is applied automatically

profiles.name: OpenAI API
profiles.description: OpenAI Responses API with your API key — full 1M context on GPT-5.6 (no 272K cap)
